detail.command:
set -e
git rev-parse HEAD
node -e "const m=require('./public/audio/manifest.json');const ids=m.events.map(e=>e.id);const cats=new Set(['music','sfx','ui','ambient']);if(m.version!==1)throw new Error('version');if(ids.length!==15)throw new Error('expected 15 events, got '+ids.length);if(new Set(ids).size!==15)throw new Error('duplicate ids');for(const e of m.events){if(!cats.has(e.category))throw new Error('bad category '+e.category);if(e.url!=='/audio/'+e.category+'/'+e.id+'.mp3')throw new Error('bad url '+e.url);if(e.optional!==true)throw new Error('not optional: '+e.id);}console.log('manifest OK: '+ids.length+' unique events');"
if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi
node_modules/.bin/tsc -b --pretty false
echo 'TYPECHECK OK'
git status --short
